question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Persuasion, Bob gets Middlemarch, Claire gets Emma, Dave gets Jane Eyre, Eve gets Ivanhoe, Fred gets Siddhartha, and Gertrude gets The Trial.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Gertrude and Bob swap books. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap books. Then, Alice and Fred swap books. Then, Claire and Alice swap books. Then, Fred and Eve swap books. Then, Claire and Eve swap books. Finally, Dave and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Claire has
Options:
(A) Persuasion
(B) Middlemarch
(C) Emma
(D) Jane Eyre
(E) Ivanhoe
(F) Siddhartha
(G) The Trial
solution:
Reader order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: Persuasion | Middlemarch | Emma | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Siddhartha | The Trial
1. Gertrude ↔ Bob: Persuasion | The Trial | Emma | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Siddhartha | Middlemarch
2. Fred ↔ Gertrude: Persuasion | The Trial | Emma | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Middlemarch | Siddhartha
3. Alice ↔ Fred: Middlemarch | The Trial | Emma | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Persuasion | Siddhartha
4. Claire ↔ Alice: Emma | The Trial | Middlemarch | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Persuasion | Siddhartha
5. Fred ↔ Eve: Emma | The Trial | Middlemarch | Jane Eyre | Persuasion | Ivanhoe | Siddhartha
6. Claire ↔ Eve: Emma | The Trial | Persuasion | Jane Eyre | Middlemarch | Ivanhoe | Siddhartha
7. Dave ↔ Alice: Jane Eyre | The Trial | Persuasion | Emma | Middlemarch | Ivanhoe | Siddhartha
Claire has Persuasion, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
